architectReview.evidence: Leader review of the cross-browser + visual change (G003). ExecCtx gained two optional fields (browser, shots_dir) with every construction site updated (rerun.rs, api.rs, gate.rs, mcp.rs pass None — behavior-preserving); browser.rs launches ctx.browser (default chromium) and screenshots to shots/<id>-<browser>.png only when shots_dir is set, keeping the prior chromium/no-shot path identical when the fields are None. run/run_collect gained a trailing browser param, threaded only from `test run --browser`; gate/MCP paths pass None so they're byte-identical. visual.rs uses the image crate (trimmed to png-only, good dep hygiene) for a real pixel-diff with a sensible tolerance + 2% regression threshold. Honest engineering: chromium needed --no-sandbox/--disable-gpu to screenshot in this container (applied for chromium only, empirically verified); webkit's missing-.so failure is surfaced as a real test failure, never faked. Small, cohesive, no slop.

executorQa.evidence: LIVE Playwright proof (executor 10-CrossBrowserVisual): `test run --browser chromium` and `--browser firefox` against a local static server both PASSED and wrote real screenshots (home-chromium.png 7254 bytes, home-firefox.png 9068 bytes, both valid PNGs) — this is the FIRST live verification that the frontend Playwright executor actually launches a browser. `test run` with no --browser stays byte-identical (deterministic, no shots). webkit FAILs with Playwright's real missing-.so block (no sudo to fix) and exit 1 — surfaced honestly, not faked. Visual diff verified by BOTH the executor and the leader (artifacts/visual-e2e.txt): identical PNGs -> diff_ratio 0.000000 / OK / exit 0; different PNGs -> diff_ratio 1.000000 / REGRESSION / exit 1. build clean, clippy 0, cargo test 16/16.
